worksheetUploader.title: Upload worksheet → AI lesson draft
worksheetUploader.body: Upload a PDF you are allowed to use. The AI drafts a lesson with 5 quiz questions and fillable on-site worksheet fields (students write their own answers; answer keys stay hidden for grading/coaching). The app also attaches a matching curriculum YouTube video + reading transcript when it finds a strong topic match. Students never see drafts until you publish. No scraping — upload only.

1.caption: This is your Student Portal — your home base for learning.

2.caption: Earn XP and levels when you finish lessons and book reports.

3.caption: Practice a little each day to grow your streak.

4.caption: Use How-to shorts anytime from Help if you get stuck.

1.caption: Your link code lets a parent connect to your progress.

2.caption: Tap Copy, then send the code to your parent or guardian.

3.caption: They paste it in Parent Portal → Link student.

4.caption: Once linked, they can assign lessons and see your wins.

1.caption: Pick a subject tab: Math, ELA, Science, Social Studies, or Reading.

2.caption: Open a lesson card to learn, quiz, and practice.

3.caption: If a subject is empty, wait for a parent to assign something — or try another tab.

4.caption: Assigned Reading is for books your parent uploaded.

1.caption: First: teach notes and video — learn the idea.

2.caption: Next: practice questions. You need about 70% to continue.

3.caption: Some lessons have a worksheet — write or draw your own answers.

4.caption: Ask AI Coach for hints — it helps you think, not fill answers for you.

5.caption: Pass the lesson to earn XP and mastery.

1.caption: Open a book your parent assigned and read in the app.

2.caption: Write a RACECE response: Restate, Answer, Cite, Explain (twice).

3.caption: Submit to AI Teacher for a score, strengths, and next steps.

4.caption: Strong reports earn XP — keep revising with the feedback.

1.caption: The daily leaderboard ranks practice time and quiz scores today.

2.caption: It resets at midnight Eastern — fresh chance every day.

3.caption: Open a lesson and practice to appear on the board.

4.caption: Cheer for classmates — learning together is the win.

1.caption: Parent Portal is for assigning work and reviewing progress.

2.caption: Use Switch to Parent Portal from the top of the dashboard.

3.caption: First step: link your student with their shareable code.

4.caption: Replay any tip from How-to shorts in Help.

1.caption: Ask your student for their Parent link code (on their dashboard).

2.caption: Paste it under Link a student and confirm.

3.caption: You can link more than one student if needed.

4.caption: Linked students show mastery, reports, and assignments here.

1.caption: Upload a text-based PDF worksheet you are allowed to use.

2.caption: AI drafts a lesson: quiz, fillable fields, and a matching video when possible.

3.caption: Review the draft — students never see it until you Publish.

4.caption: Publish to assign it. Discard if you want to try again.

1.caption: Optional advanced tool: assign a built-in Grade 5 unit by tag. Prefer AI PDF drafts for custom worksheets.

2.caption: Upload a PDF book and writing prompt for Assigned Reading.

3.caption: Linked students see new work on their Student Portal.

4.caption: Keep prompts clear — RACECE works best with a focused question.

1.caption: Open a linked student to see mastery bars and completed work.

2.caption: Read AI-graded book reports and checklist feedback.

3.caption: Celebrate effort — XP and streaks show daily practice habits.

4.caption: Assign the next lesson or book when they are ready for more.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Shia's 5th Grade Quest ("the App") helps students prepare for 5th grade at P.S./I.S. 187 and lets parents monitor progress. This page explains what information we collect and how we use it.

collect.account: Account details (email, name if provided by your sign-in provider)
collect.role: Role (student or parent) and age verification for parent accounts
collect.activity: Learning activity (tasks, XP, streaks, book reports, and related progress)
collect.files: Files parents upload (for example assigned reading PDFs)

privacy.useBody: We use this information to run accounts, save progress, grade writing with AI where enabled, and let linked parents review student work. We do not sell personal information.
privacy.googleBody: If you choose Google sign-in, Google shares basic profile information (such as email) with our authentication provider so we can create or open your account. Authentication is handled by Supabase Auth.
privacy.contactBody: Questions about this policy: use the contact email configured on the Google OAuth consent screen for this app, or reach the parent/guardian who manages the App.
